# Felix Studio

> Felix Yang is a senior software engineer with over a decade in tech. He explores how AI can help build apps, create videos, and design games.

Felix Yang uses the handle felixpy on GitHub and gofelixpy on X. He built Felix Studio with React and Three.js. Visitors can explore the room, change the view and weather, listen to music, and play Orbital Patrol. Phones open the personal profile directly.

## About

- [About Felix Yang](https://felixpy.com/about): Biography, engineering experience, and links to public profiles.

## Studio

- [Felix Studio](https://felixpy.com/): The interactive 3D workspace.
- [Felix Studio source](https://github.com/felixpy/felixpy.com): Source code and project documentation.

## Public profiles
